description: Integrates nitrogen, phosphorus and oxygen budgets through wetland redox gradients and Mississippi–Gulf seasonal hypoxia, distinguishing eutrophication, cyanobacterial toxins, oxygen measurements and the limits of nutrient-based forecasts.

related_resources.reason: 2026 Gulf survey area and storm-mixing explanation compared with June seasonal forecast.

Coastal oxygen depletion, organisms affected, global coastal historical context.
Redox acceptor sequence, wetland groundwater, nitrate/iron/sulfate dynamics and methane; sequence is generalized.
1972 cleanup, changing phosphorus inputs, bloom recurrence, and August 2014 Toledo microcystin advisory.
Lake Erie monitoring, cyanobacterial blooms and distinction between biomass and toxin measurements.
Microbial nitrogen fixation, nitrification, denitrification, anammox and overlapping pathways; no rigid universal loop.
Long storage and delayed release in soils, rivers and lake sediments after management changes.
